title_ar: [مؤسِّسو ISAP / IIJP / NIJA / Israel Society of Analytical Psychology]
note: This is a group/organization entry, not a single named person, so no individual bio page was created. ISAP (Israel Society of Analytical Psychology), IIJP and the Israel Institute of Jungian Psychology are real organizations with real documented founders/presidents (e.g. Erel Shalit, Eli Weisstub, Henry Abramovitch). Correct school/field is 'علم النفس التحليلي اليونغي' (Jungian Analytical Psychology), not the generic 'مدرسة التحليل النفسي' (which usually denotes Freudian psychoanalysis).
John L. McIntosh, Professor Emeritus of Psychology, Indiana University South Bend, leading suicidology/bereavement researcher, co-editor of 'Grief After Suicide' (2011).
Well-known American science writer (How We Decide, Imagine); English name corrected to Jonah Lehrer (not 'Lewis'). Active period matches his rise and 2012 fabrication scandal.
Well-documented Yale professor of psychology, director of Program for Recovery and Community Health, leading peer-support/recovery researcher (b. 1960). Matches school exactly.
